description: This file contains unit tests for the RingRange class, including operations like difference, complement, intersection, and containment logic. It uses the Xunit framework for testing and appears to be part of the NonSilo.Tests.Directory namespace.

classes.name: RingRangeTests
classes.description: A sealed class containing unit tests for various properties and operations of the RingRange class.

methods.name: RingRangeDifference_EquallyDividedRange
methods.description: Tests the difference operation on equally divided ranges.

methods.name: ComplementDoesNotIntersect
methods.description: Verifies that a range and its complement do not intersect.

methods.name: ComplementComplementIsEqual
methods.description: Tests that the complement of a complement of a range returns to the original range.

methods.name: RingRangeDifference_HolePunch
methods.description: Tests the difference operation resulting in a hole punch within a larger range.

methods.name: RingRangeDifference_Empty
methods.description: Checks behavior of difference when operating with an empty range.

methods.name: RingRangeDifference_Empty_Two
methods.description: Checks behavior of difference between two specific ranges.

methods.name: RingRangeIntersection
methods.description: Tests intersection properties of empty and full ranges.

methods.name: RingRangeContains
methods.description: Verifies containment logic for various ranges including wrapped ranges.

methods.name: EqualRangeInvariants
methods.description: Ensures that equally divided ranges satisfy certain invariants regarding their size and non-intersection.

methods.name: CreateEquallyDividedRange
methods.description: Helper function to create equally divided segments within the full ring range.
